_comment: REAL ROBOT launch config for vla_gui_v2.py.
Lives at config/vla_gui.robot.json; vla_robot.sh and vla_demo.sh copy it into place.
NEVER edit $VLA_GUI_CONFIG (default ~/.vla_gui.json) directly; it is overwritten on every launch.
Each step re-sets its own environment because the GUI passes its own
environment to every child. Baking it in makes the config independent
of which terminal started the GUI.
STEPS 1 AND 2 ARE DISABLED: distrobox-host-exec returns exit 127 from
inside ubuntu22-gpu, so the GUI cannot reach the host or vla-box.

steps.name: YOLO-World server (START BY HAND in vla-box)
Ollama Qwen2.5-7B (START BY HAND on host)
steps.cmd: if pgrep -x ollama >/dev/null; then echo '[ok] already running'; sleep infinity; else ollama serve; fi

steps.name: SLAM (real robot)
steps.cmd: export FASTRTPS_DEFAULT_PROFILES_FILE=$VLA_CONFIG_DIR/fastdds_super_client.xml && export ROS_DISCOVERY_SERVER="${VLA_ROBOT_IP:-10.42.0.169}:${VLA_DISCOVERY_PORT:-11811};" && ros2 launch turtlebot4_navigation slam.launch.py namespace:=/robot1

steps.name: Nav2 (real robot)
steps.cmd: export FASTRTPS_DEFAULT_PROFILES_FILE=$VLA_CONFIG_DIR/fastdds_super_client.xml && export ROS_DISCOVERY_SERVER="${VLA_ROBOT_IP:-10.42.0.169}:${VLA_DISCOVERY_PORT:-11811};" && ros2 launch turtlebot4_navigation nav2.launch.py namespace:=/robot1

steps.name: VLA agent (v28, real robot)
steps.cmd: export FASTRTPS_DEFAULT_PROFILES_FILE=$VLA_CONFIG_DIR/fastdds_super_client.xml && export ROS_DISCOVERY_SERVER="${VLA_ROBOT_IP:-10.42.0.169}:${VLA_DISCOVERY_PORT:-11811};" && export VLA_NS=/robot1 && unset VLA_RAW_RGB VLA_RAW_DEPTH && cd $VLA_ROOT && python3 $VLA_SRC_DIR/vla_agent_v28.py

steps.name: Voice input (Whisper, push-to-talk)
steps.cmd: export FASTRTPS_DEFAULT_PROFILES_FILE=$VLA_CONFIG_DIR/fastdds_super_client.xml && export ROS_DISCOVERY_SERVER="${VLA_ROBOT_IP:-10.42.0.169}:${VLA_DISCOVERY_PORT:-11811};" && export VLA_NS=/robot1 && cd $VLA_ROOT && python3 $VLA_SRC_DIR/voice_command.py --mode ptt --mic pulse --device cpu --compute int8
